//: A `rewrite` REPLACES the request path with the destination, so FastAPI saw
/api/index for every request and answered 404 to all of them. A legacy
`route` whose dest is the function file preserves the original path, which
is what an ASGI app needs in order to route at all.
`builds` and `routes` cannot be combined with `rewrites`/`functions`, which
is why the modern keys are gone.
